answer.answer: Atlas Runner's supported concurrency changed between versions 1.0 and 1.1. Version 1.0 supported up to 8 concurrent jobs (atlas-release-1), and version 1.1 raised the supported limit from 8 to 16 concurrent jobs (atlas-release-2). Both snapshots belong to the same subject (subject_id: atlas-runner) and lineage (lineage_id: atlas-release), so the change is internally consistent across the release notes. Current state, per the latest supplied snapshot (the 1.1 release notes): Atlas Runner supports up to 16 concurrent jobs (atlas-release-2). The 8-job figure remains historically valid as a description of version 1.0 specifically (atlas-release-1). Unresolved: the sources contain no snapshots after 1.1, so any later changes to the limit cannot be confirmed; the snapshots also do not specify whether the limit is configurable or a hard cap, nor do they provide release dates.
